{{Short description|none}}

This article lists '''[[List of universities in Australia|universities in Australia]]''' that offer higher education study options in the '''[[mathematical sciences]]''' at the [[undergraduate]] and [[postgraduate|postgraduate level]]. 34 Australian universities currently offer higher education study options in the mathematical sciences. Of the 39 members of [[Universities Australia]], only four do not offer mathematical science qualifications: [[Charles Darwin University]], [[Central Queensland University]], [[Southern Cross University]] (although it does offer mathematics education degrees),<ref>{{cite web |title=EDUC2003 - Mathematics: Secondary Curriculum and Pedagogy I – 2024 - SCU |url=https://www.scu.edu.au/study/units/educ2003/ |website=www.scu.edu.au |publisher=Southern Cross University |access-date=4 February 2024 |language=en}}</ref> and [[Victoria University (Australia)|Victoria University]] (does offer qualifications in mathematics education).<ref>{{cite web |title=Mathematics (Education) |url=https://www.vu.edu.au/unitsets/mathematics-education--emamth |website=vu.edu.au |publisher=Victoria University |access-date=4 February 2024 |archive-date=4 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240204053136/https://www.vu.edu.au/unitsets/mathematics-education--emamth |url-status=live }}</ref> Students can also study some mathematical science courses online via the ACE Network of the [[Australian Mathematical Sciences Institute]].<ref>{{cite web |title=AMSI ACE Network |url=https://rhed.amsi.org.au/ace/ |website=Research and Higher Education |publisher=Australian Mathematical Sciences Institute |access-date=4 February 2024 |language=en-AU |archive-date=4 February 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240204074013/https://rhed.amsi.org.au/ace/ |url-status=live }}</ref>
